cues: Two forces pulling on one point have a single equivalent force, the resultant: the diagonal of the parallelogram they make.
Five newtons and three newtons at sixty degrees combine into exactly seven.
Close the angle and the resultant grows to eight; open it to one eighty and it shrinks to two.
text: Two forces pulling on one point have a single equivalent force, the resultant: the diagonal of the parallelogram they make. Five newtons and three newtons at sixty degrees combine into exactly seven. Close the angle and the resultant grows to eight; open it to one eighty and it shrinks to two.
